summary: QV.25.086 analysis notebook for Drelvessa Therapeutics SAS. It records the docking set-up against the client's crystal-derived receptor models, the rule used to keep or drop conserved pocket waters, and the ranked solvent-facing substitution designs. The solvent-facing vector is the one Drelvessa took into its next chemistry cycle, as set out in the client report (P42).
